reasons: STRUCTURAL GAP (narrowed): this plan is PARTIALLY participant-directed per its own Form 5500 codes (2H, no 2G/404(c) code filed). A trustee-directed sleeve could hold this wrapper directly, and the daily-menu constraint (this wrapper deals 4x/year) applies only to the participant-directed portion (cell 3.5).

Capacity: 4x per year at 5.0% of outstanding shares per quarter (Rule 13e-4 issuer tenders, board-discretionary, may suspend or terminate at any time). This is a FUND-level cap, and at a 5% plan allocation the plan's position is far inside it unless offers are oversubscribed.

Scenario demand (illustrative): 13.7% of the position per year vs 20% annual wrapper capacity. THIN HEADROOM: demand consumes over 60% of wrapper capacity, so proration in any oversubscribed quarter would push the shortfall into the next window.

Cadence reliability evidence: 12 consecutive quarterly tenders completed FY2023-FY2025, no disclosed suspension. Demand accelerating (FY2025 repurchases ~$2.00B vs $639M FY2024, May 2026 offer sized at the full 5% cap). Shares TENDERED vs repurchased not disclosed, so proration cannot be ruled out from filings (3.3).
Early repurchase economics: none - N-2 fee table shows no early withdrawal charge for any class (2.7). Relevant to participant-level churn (2.7).

stressed_scenario.assumptions: tail turnover x2, active turnover x1.5 vs base scenario
stressed_scenario.outcome: EXCEEDS annual wrapper capacity. Unmet demand rolls into later windows (gating-equivalent outcome)
